title.text: What if your phone battery was your life?

lines.l_swipe: Every swipe costs you a little life.
lines.l_outlet: One free outlet. Someone was faster.
lines.l_call: Then your boss starts a video call.
lines.l_lowpower: Low power mode. You stop moving.
lines.l_powerbank: A stranger shares a power bank!
lines.l_storm: Then a storm hits the city.
lines.l_kiosk: Every charger in town is dead.
lines.l_home: But your home still has light.
